value.body: Psychology as a major studies how people think, feel and behave — cognitive, developmental, social and abnormal psychology, plus research methods and statistics, with lab practicals. It is offered as a B.A. or a B.Sc., depending on the university.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Central and many other universities admit through CUET-UG, where the subject itself can be one of the tests counted; others admit on Class 12 marks or their own test. Some universities fix the major at admission; others, under the NEP four-year programme, let students settle it after the first year. Some B.Sc. Psychology programmes expect science subjects in Class 12.

value.title: At a glance
items: A bachelor's degree alone does not qualify you to practise as a psychologist or therapist; that needs postgraduate training.

Practising as a clinical psychologist requires registration with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) after an RCI-recognised programme; the qualifying route has been changing, so check current RCI rules.
Graduate-level work is often in HR, research assistance, NGOs, user research and support roles.
Statistics and research methods are a substantial part of the course.
